claims: The Hunger Games is a dystopian YA franchise created by Suzanne Collins.
The Hunger Games is set in the nation of Panem.
In The Hunger Games, teens are forced to fight to the death in a televised battle royale.
The Hunger Games trilogy consists of The Hunger Games (2008), Catching Fire (2009), and Mockingjay (2010).
The Hunger Games trilogy has sold over 100 million copies worldwide.
The Hunger Games trilogy was adapted into a film series starring Jennifer Lawrence as Katniss Everdeen.
As punishment for a past rebellion, the Capitol forces its twelve districts to select one boy and one girl (tributes) aged 12–18 to compete in the annual Games.
The story focuses on Katniss Everdeen.
Katniss Everdeen volunteers for her sister.
Peeta Mellark is Katniss Everdeen's fellow District 12 tribute.
The Hunger Games film series includes The Hunger Games (2012).
The Hunger Games film series includes Catching Fire (2013).
The Hunger Games film series includes Mockingjay Part 1 (2014).
The Hunger Games film series includes Mockingjay Part 2 (2015).
The Hunger Games film series includes the prequel The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes (2023).
A new film titled Sunrise on the Reaping is scheduled for release in November 2026.
The Hunger Games series draws inspiration from Greek mythology.
The Hunger Games series draws inspiration from modern reality TV.
